findings.finding: Full testing revealed F16/R32 WDL component drift up to 23.24 points; native reference checks confirm the larger F16 discrepancy. The earlier 1.96-point observation does not automatically cover it.
findings.action: Record explicit user acceptance of the expanded documented drift or reopen baseline engineering. Keep measurements and raw failures intact. Review remains open: True

findings.finding: The predefined signed-margin hard subset has 1650 roots and zero accuracy for both baselines. Validation tau is negative, so baseline failure on this subset follows from the rule. Further degradation has a floor effect.
findings.action: Preserve the original subset/results. Before Week 2 claims, discuss a separately registered baseline-correct/near-boundary supplemental subset using validation, with joint approval and explicit post-selection safeguards. Do not retroactively replace the current metric or tune from these test results.

findings.finding: The engineering I1 pilot has substantial numerical drift and no latency gain over F16. Expanded coverage was chosen by the preregistered coverage/latency rule, not by accuracy.
findings.action: Week 2 uses the registered full-calibration ladder and validation selection. Do not present the pilot as a successful accuracy/speed optimization or final test result.

findings.finding: The ModelOpt Q/DQ ONNX pilot stores selected weight source constants in FP16 followed by QuantizeLinear; TensorRT folds constants and executes INT8 operands. 99.9905% is selected matrix-parameter coverage, not a claim that 99.9905% of ONNX-file bytes are INT8.
findings.action: Report ONNX and saved-engine sizes separately. If compact INT8 initializers are needed in Week 2, treat canonical constant folding as an explicit serializer change, verify numerical equivalence and re-audit resulting engines.

findings.finding: INT8 matrix kernels use INT32 accumulation and may output FP32 dequantized intermediates, FP16 or requantized INT8. The four unselected weighted operations use FP16, with FP32 normalization computation requested.
findings.action: Use per-layer inspector/kernel evidence. Do not describe all non-INT8 execution as uniformly FP16 or claim all model parameters are INT8.

findings.finding: Actual lc0 GPU backend integration, fixed-node and one-second search, systems/energy evidence, DTZ move ranking and teammate review are unverified.
findings.action: A-side Week 1 completion is distinct from joint C1. Resolve B01-B08 and joint review before opening comparable Week 2 studies.

findings.finding: The accepted F16 engine is device/runtime-specific and has a user-accepted original numerical exception. Engine rebuilds can select different tactics.
findings.action: Preserve the exact binary. Rebuilding or integrating a different engine requires fresh parity/precision checks; the old exception is not blanket acceptance.
